title: App Shot Editor compose plan
description: Input to `appshot lint|compose|variants|publish`. The skill writes this after pairing benefits with uploaded screenshots. Every field added in shot-dsl 0.4.0 (style, focus, crop, presentation, tilt, badge) and 0.5.0 (art, style.hero / rhythm / callouts / shadows, tonal palettes, panorama motifs, per-screen callout / mascot) is optional — a plan without them composes (0.5.0 adds a default hero on screen 1; `style.hero: false` turns it off). Handoffs are capped at 256 KB: lint errors above it and warns above 80%.

canvasWidth.description: Usually OMIT (recommended). When omitted, each screen gets its device class's canvas (phone 280×608, tablet 450×600, laptop 608×380 editor units) and the editor exports at the real App Store sizes — the layout is identical either way because every layer is sized proportionally to the canvas. Only set this (together with canvasHeight) if you have a specific reason to pin one canvas size, and only for a single-device plan: it forces ONE size across ALL screens, so a mixed-device plan would squeeze e.g. iPad screens into a phone-shaped canvas.

canvasHeight.description: See canvasWidth — usually omit; if set, set both, and only for a single-device plan.

headline.description:
Short, benefit-led headline: 3–5 words, ≤ 2 lines at the set size (e.g. "Hear the word. Spell it."). Rendered bold at ONE size for the whole set (~8.5% of canvas width) — never shrunk; longer copy triggers a lint warning and grows the reserved text area for every screen. Cut, don't shrink. 0.5.0: write the line break you want with 
 ("Ace every
spelling test") — it is always kept; only a line too wide for the text box is broken further. Without 
 the composer balances the lines (no single word stranded). A single word wider than the box is an error.

headlineColor.description: Hex. An explicit value always wins. If omitted: white on a screen's own explicit background; on a style.palette background or inside a panorama span, white or near-black — whichever reads best against the background actually behind the text.

subheadline.description: Optional supporting line under the headline — ≤ 1 line (≈ 6–7 words at phone size). Rendered at ~55% of the headline size, slightly muted. Omit when the headline says it all.

subheadlineColor.description: Hex color for the subheadline. Defaults to headlineColor at 85% opacity.

layout.description: text-top (default): text above, device below — it clears the bottom by ≥4% or bleeds ≥12% of its height (never 'just touching'). text-bottom: the same mirrored (device on top, text below). device-bleed: a hero device pushed lower, bleeding more. Devices are ≤ 90% of the width. Screens sharing a layout (and device/presentation/tilt) share one scale + baseline; `variants` sets every layout to text-top.

deviceId.description: Device frame id (e.g. iphone_16_pro, pixel_9_pro, ipad_pro_13_m4).

url.description: Asset url from the upload manifest.

background.description: Required unless style.palette is set (then omit it to use the palette). Keep one cohesive palette across the set.

focus.description: The screenshot's selling UI as fractions of its height (0 = top, 1 = bottom), marked after LOOKING at the screenshot. Its corners always stay ≥2% inside every canvas edge and panorama seam (tilted devices included; a bleed/tilt is reduced to keep it). A zoom card too small for the band warns zoom-focus-cropped.

crop.description: Zoom crop as fractions of the screenshot (x + w ≤ 1, y + h ≤ 1). Used by presentation zoom; defaults to the focus band.

tilt.description: Overrides the style tilt for this screen (degrees, clockwise).

badge.description: Short social-proof pill above the headline (1–3 words, e.g. "Teacher-approved", "Editors' Choice"). A badge row is reserved on every screen of the set so headlines stay aligned.

callout.description: 0.5.0 magnified callout of this screen's selling element: a crop of the same screenshot shown 1.6–2.2× larger as a rounded card over the device, never over the text, and hiding at most 35% of the rest of the focus band (it is moved, shrunk, or skipped with callout-skipped). Keep it ≤ ~60% of the screenshot width. `false` opts out of an auto callout.

style.description: Set-wide style. The composer always applies the pro rules: one device scale / baseline / headline size per set, text area reserved for the tallest text block, devices ≤ 90% of the width keeping 5% side margins, no device 'just touching' the bottom (it clears by ≥4% of the height or bleeds by ≥12% of the device), and marked focus bands kept inside every edge and seam.

presentation.description: device: framed mockup. frameless: the bare screenshot, rounded + soft shadow. zoom: a magnified crop of each screen's `crop` (else the centre of its `focus` band), rounded + shadow.

tilt.description: Degrees (clockwise) for the screens in tiltScreens. Rotation is an accent: 4–12°, on at most 1–2 screens (hero / panorama), never the core-feature explainer. A tilted device prefers a bleed (auto/deep). If a tilted device, frameless screenshot or zoom card can't keep 5% side margins with its focus band inside, it shrinks ≤ 20% (a zoom card keeps its aspect) and then the tilt is reduced (tilt-reduced warning).

tiltScreens.description: 0-based screen indices that get `tilt`. Default: none.

bleed.description: auto: the no-tangent rule — a device that clears the edge by ≥4% stays; one that would touch it bleeds decisively (≥12%, growing toward the 90%-width cap, then shifting down), clearing with a margin only if every such bleed would crop its focus band. none: devices always fully visible. deep: bleed ≥25% of the device (reduced if it would crop a focus band).

palette.description: Background system for screens that omit `background`, with ONE text colour for the whole set that passes WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1) on every palette background — the composer adjusts the palette tones (never explicit backgrounds) until it does. tonal (recommended): colors = [brand base, accent?] from the app icon / UI → light↔deep steps of the base hue per screen, text in a deep (or pale) tint of the same hue, badges in the accent. family: every screen shares one gradient through `colors`. sequence: screen i uses colors[i % n] as a soft gradient.

tone.description: tonal only. light: pale tints + dark text. vivid: around the brand colour. deep: richer, darker, warmer steps.

panorama.description: Adjacent screens sharing one continuous background: the span's first screen's background runs across the span. A solid colour stays solid; a linear gradient keeps its stops and angle (none → corner-to-corner diagonal); radial gradients and explicit coords can't span screens and are rejected. Each screen still works alone in search: its headline and focus UI stay inside it, and seam orbs avoid the text. In the editor the halves are independent layers. A tonal palette runs ONE ramp through the span's tones. `spans` may be omitted to only pick the `decoration` that `appshot variants` concept C uses.

spans.description: Runs of adjacent, ascending screen indices, e.g. [[0, 1], [2, 3]]. A screen may be in at most one span; all screens of a span must share a canvas size (device class).

straddle.description: Devices that cross a seam into the next screen (emitted on both screens, seam-aligned): true = the first screen of every span, or a list of span-start screen indices (e.g. [0] — the hero only). Keep it to ONE per set (more is lint-warned). Limited so a marked focus band stays inside its screen, or skipped. 0.5.0: a straddle must show ≥ 18% of the device on the next screen; otherwise it is skipped (straddle-skipped) — a sliver reads as a glitch.

decoration.description: orbs: soft circles on each seam. honeycomb / wave: one continuous motif path across the whole span, crossing every seam (pick what fits the brand — honeycomb for a bee, wave for most). none.

font.description: Font for all text — the editor's font list (pick the closest to the brand font). Line wraps are estimated with per-font metrics.

hero.description: 0.5.0 hero screen (default ON for screen 1 — `false` turns it off): headline ≈1.25× the set size (stepped down if that would add a line), its own device pose with a deeper bleed, an optional badge and mascot. It sells the promise; the other screens keep one shared system.

badge.description: Hero badge (else the screen's own). Only TRUE, checkable facts ("Grades 1–12", "No ads") — never invented awards or ratings.

rhythm.description: 0.5.0 accent rhythm: every `every`-th screen (the 4th, 8th… for 4) gets an accent treatment so the set isn't one template. Accents keep the shared type size.

treatment.description: text-bottom: device on top (bleeding off the top), text below. callout: a magnified callout (explicit, else from focus) + a deeper bleed.

callouts.description: 0.5.0. auto: screens without an explicit `callout` get one derived from a TIGHT focus band (≤ 50% of the height; a left-aligned slice at its top). Explicit `callout` crops are always used; mark them on the selling screens.

shadows.description: 0.5.0 soft brand-tinted drop shadows on devices, frameless screenshots, callouts and mascots.

art.description: 0.5.0 brand art (mascots). Upload the transparent PNG with `appshot upload` like a screenshot and copy its manifest entry here; referenced by `mascot.art`.

url.description: The uploaded asset URL from the upload manifest.

faces.description: Which way the character faces (so the composer can turn it toward the canvas).

crop.description: A rectangle as fractions (0–1) of the screenshot: x, y = top-left; w, h = size. Must stay inside (x + w ≤ 1, y + h ≤ 1).

mascot.description: Brand art (a mascot) placed with intent: it never covers the text, a callout or the focus band's core, and may overlap the device edge. Candidates for the anchor are tried first, then the other anchors, at 100/85/70% size; if none fits the screen gets a mascot-skipped warning.

art.description: The `id` of an entry in plan.art.

anchor.description: headline: beside the headline's last/first line (or over the device's top corner under it). device-top: perched on the device's top corner. device-side: on the device's side edge (inside the canvas). seam: centred on the panorama seam to the next screen (or the previous one for a span's last screen), emitted on both screens — only in a panorama span.

size.description: Rendered width ÷ canvas width. Default 0.3 on the hero, 0.22 elsewhere.

flip.description: Mirror horizontally. Default: face into the canvas when the art declares `faces`.
